## README.md

[Minimap Button Collector logo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikarregui/MinimapButtonCollector/main/assets/logo.png)

# MinimapButtonCollector

> One trigger on your minimap. Click it, your addon buttons appear in a clean side panel. Click one, it closes. Done.
> 
>
[Release](https://github.com/mikarregui/MinimapButtonCollector/releases) [License: MIT](https://github.com/mikarregui/MinimapButtonCollector/blob/main/LICENSE) [GitHub downloads](https://github.com/mikarregui/MinimapButtonCollector/releases) [CurseForge downloads](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/minimap-button-collector) [Issues](https://github.com/mikarregui/MinimapButtonCollector/issues) [Stars](https://github.com/mikarregui/MinimapButtonCollector/stargazers)

> Target client: **World of Warcraft — The Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary Edition** (2.5.5, Interface `20505` ).
> Available on **[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/mikarregui/MinimapButtonCollector/releases)** , **[CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/minimap-button-collector)** , and **[Wago](https://addons.wago.io/addons/minimapbuttoncollector)** .
> 
>
[Side-by-side comparison: cluttered minimap with 8 addon buttons (Without MBC) versus a clean minimap with a single trigger and a panel on demand (With MBC).](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikarregui/MinimapButtonCollector/main/assets/mbc-comparison-readme.gif)

## Why

Install a handful of addons and your minimap edge turns into a ring of overlapping little buttons. Finding the one you want becomes a game in itself. MinimapButtonCollector reclaims that space: a single trigger sits on the minimap, and when you click it, all the collected addon buttons appear in a clean side panel anchored to the minimap.

## Features

* **Hybrid detection** — catches modern LibDBIcon buttons (including those registered after login, captured live) and legacy minimap buttons
* **Side panel layout** — buttons appear in a floating panel anchored to a configurable corner of the minimap. Never covers the map itself, so raid / BG / quest navigation stays readable
* **Per-button exclusion** — keep individual buttons on the minimap instead of collecting them, ideal for icons whose look communicates state at a glance
* **Reorder inside the panel** — arrange collected buttons in the order that makes sense for you, per character
* **Smooth fade transition** — 200 ms panel fade, no jarring pop-in
* **Auto-close** — click any addon button and the panel closes on its own
* **Draggable trigger** — move it anywhere around the minimap edge; position persists per-character
* **Non-modal** — the panel coexists with world interactions (loot, NPCs, spells) and can be opened or kept open during combat
* **Native settings** — `/mbc config` or right-click the trigger opens a Blizzard-style settings panel

## Installation

### Via addon manager (recommended)

Available on [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/minimap-button-collector) and [Wago](https://addons.wago.io/addons/minimapbuttoncollector) .

...

|`/mbc exclude <ButtonName>` |Keep a specific button on the minimap (never collect it). Case-sensitive — use `/mbc list` to see exact names |
|`/mbc include <ButtonName>` |Undo an exclusion; the button goes back into the panel |
|`/mbc rescan` |Re-detect minimap buttons (rarely needed — new LibDBIcon buttons are captured live) |
|`/mbc list` |Print a summary of collected buttons grouped by source |
|`/mbc list full` |Print the full list of collected buttons (debug) |

## Compatibility

The side panel is an independent frame anchored to the minimap via `SetPoint` . It does not manipulate the minimap's alpha or reparent Blizzard frames, so it coexists cleanly with ElvUI minimap skinning and other addons that reshape the minimap.

## Development

This repo is set up for serious iteration. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/mikarregui/MinimapButtonCollector/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for the full workflow. Architectural decisions are recorded in [docs/adr/](https://github.

## **Loot Toast UI**

**Lightweight • Polished • Modern Feedback System**

**Loot Toast UI** is a sleek, minimal addon that displays modern, animated toasts whenever you loot items, earn gold, or gain currencies.  
It replaces Blizzard’s default chat spam with smooth, stacked pop-ups that fade and slide elegantly — like a true modern RPG notification system.

Whether you’re farming raids, selling items, or trading currencies, every gain or loss is instantly visualized with color-coded icons, gradients, and merge animations that keep your screen clean.

* * *

### **🎉 Highlights**

**Modern Toast Notifications**
* Gold, Silver, Copper — separate toasts for gains and losses
* Item loot — full quality colors and icons
* Currency gains — supports all tracked currencies
* Smooth stacking — merges repeated events (e.g. rapid sales or looting stacks)

**Polished UI**

* Subtle gradient backgrounds and colored borders
* Dynamic slide-in animation with soft fadeout
* Auto-stacking: multiple identical events combine into one toast
* Smart spacing: new toasts reposition fluidly
* Hover pause: hover a toast to pause its fadeout timer

**Performance**

* 100% event-driven (no polling, no CPU drain)
* Optimized for high-frequency events (mass looting, vendors, AH)
* Minimal memory churn — every toast reuses efficient memory paths

* * *

### **💰 What It Tracks**

**Money Changes**

* Gold gained (sales, quest rewards, etc.)
* Gold spent (repairs, purchases, etc.)
* Merges repeated transactions for clarity
* Color-coded feedback for gain/loss

**Item Loot**
* Tracks all items looted, received, or created
* Displays item name, icon, and stack count
* Uses Blizzard item quality colors

**Currencies**

* Tracks all in-game currencies (Anima, Flightstones, etc.)
* Detects both slot-looted and system-granted currencies
* Icon and quantity shown with subtle blue gradient styling

* * *

### **⚙️ Commands**

`/loottoast` — toggles move/lock mode for repositioning the anchor.  
Simply drag the “Loot Toast Anchor” to your preferred location, then lock again.

* * *

### **🎨 Customization (in-game)**

* **Anchor:** movable & saved per character
* **Stacking:** auto-combines repeated events (e.g. 5 small sales = 1 toast)
* **Timing:** each toast lasts 5 seconds (resets when updated or hovered)
* **Animations:** smooth easing (no snapping or jitter)
* **Colors:** automatically use item quality and gold/silver/copper tones

* * *

### **⚡ Performance**

Built for reliability and minimalism:
* Fully event-driven — reacts to actual loot/money/currency events
* No OnUpdate loops — zero background processing
* Dynamic pooling — toasts recycle instantly when faded
* Optimized layout — repositions only when visible

* * *

### **🧩 Integrations (optional)**

Currently self-contained (no dependencies).  
Future compatibility planned for:

* **Masque** — custom toast skins
* **SharedMedia** — fonts, textures, gradients

* * *

### **🪙 How to Use**

1. Type **/loottoast move** to unlock and drag the toast anchor.
2. Lock it again with **/loottoast move** .
3. Loot items, gain gold, or earn currencies — watch them animate in real-time.
4. Hover a toast to pause its fadeout, or just let it slide away naturally.

* * *

### **🔧 Compatibility**

* **Retail WoW** (Dragonflight / The War Within)
* Supports all currencies and loot formats
* Works seamlessly with any UI or inventory addon
* No taint, no chat spam, no reload issues

* * *

### **💬 Feedback & Support**
Found a bug? Have an idea for new toast styles (e.g. achievements, profession gains)?  
Leave a comment on the project page or contact **Fendoran** on CurseForge.

* * *

✨ _Clean, modern, responsive loot notifications — because every coin deserves style._
